title: Verification evidence manifest
responsibility: Lists a verification run’s own captures and test logs, then records their identities and Git or LFS storage beside the serialized record.

inputs.name: recordFiles.record
inputs.description: Verification record whose scenario captures and test logs should be listed. Captures from referenced scenarios belong to their original record and are excluded.

inputs.name: evidenceManifest.record
inputs.description: Verification record supplying id, source commit and tree, status, captures and logs for the evidence manifest.

inputs.name: evidenceManifest.recordJson
inputs.description: Exact serialized record.json bytes to hash and count; they are not regenerated from the supplied object.

outputs.name: recordFiles
outputs.description: Unique file entries in capture-then-log order, retaining the first entry for each path and carrying hashes, byte sizes and capture media types.

outputs.name: evidenceManifest
outputs.description: Version 1 evidence manifest with record identity, source and status, followed by record.json and the run’s own files. Hash and size for record.json come from the supplied bytes; media extensions select LFS and other files use Git.
